The match was held on April 18 2026 and would be won by the YouTube All-Stars after going to a penalty shootout.[1][2][1] Jynxzi would be awarded Man of the Match for his performance.[3] The event would raise £6,218,875, a record for all their charity matches.[4] Contents 1 Details 2 Players 3 Results 3.1 Summary 3.1.1 First half 3.1.2 Second half 3.1.3 Penalty shootout 3.2 Goals 4 Statistics 4.1 Goals 4.2 Assists 5 Trivia 6 References Details Last year in 2025, a sell-out Sidemen FC charity match at Wembley notably raised £4.7 million for charities including BBC Children in Need. Sidemen FC lead the head-to-head, winning four of the previous six games against the YouTube Allstars. The all-time aggregate score is a remarkable 39-26 in favour of the Sidemen. The previous fixture was the first to end in a draw (9-9) as the YouTube Allstars went 5-4 on penalties thanks to a Sketch penalty shootout save against Miniminter following an 18-goal thriller in 2025. Sidemen announced the return of their highly popular charity match for 2026.[5] Tickets cost £15 - 35 and was played at Wembley Stadium, London. The Sidemen split up amongst the teams for the game. Behzinga, KSI and Miniminter are on the Allstars' team, while Vikkstar, Wroetoshaw, Zerkaa, and TBJZL stay in Sidemen FC. On March 22, 2026, the Sidemen held a draft for the two teams.[6] The broadcast featured Dutch legend Edgar Davids, former England winger Shaun Wright-Phillips, and Arsenal's Michelle Agyemang. Calfreezy is managing the YouTube Allstars with an athletic "NFL" style, while Jack Joseph leads Sidemen FC in a more eccentric outfit involving a hat and cane. Starting for Sidemen FC was goalee XQC AmineMaTrue, Wroetoshaw, Marlon, Deji; LazarBeam, Zerkaa, ChrisMD, TBJZL; Vikkstar123, and Niko while ArthurTV, AJ Shabeel, Adapt, Jynxi, Lacy, AB were substitutes. YouTube Allstars began with goalee Sketch, JasonTheWeen, AngryGinge, MrWhoseTheBoss, Danny Aarons; CarryMinati, Behzinga, KSI, Ibai; Stable Ronaldo, Miniminter while ItalianBach, Max Fosh, George Clarkey, WillNE, Squeezie, NYKChazza were substitutes. English rapper Tinie Tempah would be the surprise musical performer during halftime.[7] Players Full Line Up Source: Twitter: Sidemen [8] No. SDMN F.C. The Sidemen nearly had an opener as Niko clots the ball past Sketch following a long ball from Wroetoshaw. However, the flag goes up for a controversial disallowed goal. On second viewing, the run was started inside his own half. Instead AngryGinge scores the opening goal to the left-sided corner and heads past xQc. TBJZL curls one from the left of the area but is saved by Sketch. TBJZL bends a delightful Trivela from the right wing, and it loops over a helpless Sketch. Marlon was recently subbed off and then put back on, but has left his mark after ChrisMD slides him in down the right-central channel. Sketch comes out slightly, but he can't do anything to stop a deft sidefoot. ItalianBach cuts inside after Miniminter plays him in, yet he can't fire either side of xQc. Marlon plays Vikkstar in on the penalty spot, and Sketch comes out to divert the central shot behind for a corner. Marlon is also denied by Sketch and the ball is then fed across the box for AB to aim at an open goal that he scuffs. Up the other end, ItalianBach fluffs a shot straight at xQc yet again. After JasonTheWeen hits the floor in the box following a scuffle with TBJZL, the on-field review from Clattenburg gives a penalty to the red team. Ween punts the spot-kick tamely to the right, and XQC gets it down sharply. Miniminter touches down and drives low through XQC's legs. ItalianBach passes the ball back to his keeper Sketch, and he picks the ball up to give away an indirect free-kick inside the area. The indirect free-kick is smashed goalbound, but the secondary ball comes in for Ginge to head off the line from Marlon. Shabeel then nearly scores as Sketch falls when rushing out. ChrisMD shoots from range, and it loops up off AngryGinge, bounces off the turf and over Sketch. WillNE is back on the line to try and clear, but he can't. Dixon then runs to the corner, taking off his shirt to reveal another tee that has Theo Baker on it. ChrisMD sparks another great move into life, and the ball comes back in from the right, with Jynxzi finishing first-time past a helpless Sketch in the Allstars' goal. At the third time of asking, ItalianBach turns away nicely before cutely finishing past xQc down low to the left for his first goal. Before half-time, Miniminter lands another goal that cuts back inside 9AmineMaTue before smashing the ball past XQC. Second half Danny Aarons gallops down the left channel and breaches the box. He gets his head up and then absolutely belts the ball into the bottom-left corner for his first goal in the charity's history before executing a wonderful knee slide in the corner. KSI deals with some sagging shorts well and floats a great ball over the top. Chazza runs on and cuts in on the left before firing past a weak xQc dive to find the bottom-right corner. Stable Ronaldo cuts down Zerkaa, and after a brief on-field review, it's a penalty. AJ Shabeel takes 3-5 business days on the run-up, only to side-foot it straight at Sketch, whose crisp packet wrists push it into the roof of the net for a weak penalty. Sidemen pressure refuses to let up, and after initially striking the post, the ball is recycled. ChrisMD runs down the left before crossing. Niko helps it on, and Zerkaa bumbles it into a vacant goal with Sketch stuck at his near post. As a Mexican wave glides around the stadium, ArthurTV has a speculative go on goal but it's just wide of the base of the left post. WillNE comes in and Fosh bicycle kicks it. It drops for Will, who pokes it into the roof of the net for his first charity goal since 2022's bout. He races away and karate kicks the corner flag like Jean-Philippe Mateta!. Clarkey is played in and shrugs off his marker, only to put the ball straight at xQc. ChrisMD and ArthurTV work well together, before the latter squares from the right as Sketch races out. Vik has the whole goal to his mercy and taps it home in jubilant fashion for the first time since 2022. AB loops a great shot over Sketch from the left for his first charity goal while KSI squeezes one past XQC for his first goal since 2018 (that wasn't an own-goal or penalty). The ball comes in, and Niko chests it down brilliantly, before turning a lashed effort past Sketch. Miniminter gets in down the left and whacks an effort off and away off the crossbar. After ArthurTV hits the post from the right of the area, it hits Sketch's back before Jynxzi taps home for his second goal of the night. Miniminter sends a pass in behind, and XQC does well to charge out and stop a nailed-on goal. Miniminter wins back possession on the edge of the area and belts a merciless effort into the bottom-left corner for a hat trick. This goal meant record status, beating 2025's tally of 18 goals. Sidemen stopper xQc does really well to parry a Chazza free-kick before stopping Clarkey in equal measure. A sweet ball from Chazza plays Bach in on the right. He has Aarons in the box but shoots and is blocked. ItalianBach pings a low drive from range, and it has enough movement on it to confuse xQc and squeeze underneath for a tie game. While Jynxi is denied a hat-trick at one end, the following corner is defended. Bach then sends Clarkey away on the right, and he flashes a shot across the face. Penalty shootout After much chatter in the centre circle, and a coin toss with Mark Clattenburg, the YouTube Allstars took the first penalty kick. Even the managers have boots on as Allstars gaffer Cal Freezy will be the first taker. Calfreezy blasts the ball through xQc and straight down the middle for 1-0 in the shootout. In comparison, SDMN FC coach Joseph goes for the top-right corner, but hits the crossbar. Ibai tucks his curling penalty into the bottom-left corner with xQc rooted for 2-0. SDMN FC miss again after Lazarbeam bricks it. Fosh wraps a lovely shot past xQc from 12 yards for 3-0. ChrisMD simply rolls it home after sending Sketch the wrong way for SDMN FC's only penalty of the shootout. Mrwhosetheboss drives home the 4th penalty to seal it for the All-Stars. It ends 4-1 on spot-kicks.
